description: DXF writer rounded arc angles to 9 decimals; for large apex radii the arc end points moved by more than the re-import tolerance and gate G15 failed although the geometry was right. Found by the stress campaign on 2026-11-19; fixed by exact round-trip number formatting in nf-dxf.

cases.note: Changed on 2026-11-19 (validation defect D6): this sector is 99.944 % of a full turn. Right cones now refuse a sector of 99.9 % or more, the rule the eccentric reducer always applied. The arc-precision coverage of this case is kept by the next case: same radii, sector 99.8 %.
Replacement for the case above (D6): same radii, sector 99.8 % of a full turn.
